en.title: Maximum Pay After Adding Workdays
en.description:
A workday earns fixedPay, plus an extra bonus if the previous day was also a workday. You may change at most k rest days 0 into workdays 1; existing workdays cannot be removed. Find the maximum income. In the original example 100101, changing two days can give 111101; the old explanation missed one digit, and the correct income is 29.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site; missing numeric bounds and recoveries of source typos are all stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains n k fixedPay bonus, and the second line contains a 01 string; complete OCR bounds 1≤k≤n≤200000, 1≤fixedPay,bonus≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 10; 29; 30. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: All gains are positive, so add as many workdays as possible; first fill the shortest interior 0 segments to connect work blocks, then use the remaining added days to extend existing work blocks. If the string is all 0s, place the added days as one contiguous segment.
